# Keys and commands

Everything here is also on `?` (`:help`) inside the app, which draws the same
lists. Keys act on whatever has focus: the row under the cursor in the list, or
the document in the focused tile. Inside the editor the full vim keymap is live,
and `:` opens the command line, where `Tab` completes commands and their
arguments and `↑` / `↓` recall earlier lines.

## Keys

### Browsing and reading

| key | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `1 … 9 · 0` | switch to that space, like a workspace |
| `Shift 1 … 9` | send the marked nodes, or the selected one, to that space |
| `Tab · Shift-Tab` | next / previous space |
| `w` | overview of every space — hjkl, then Enter |
| `f` | fullscreen the focused pane or tile; again or Esc to leave |
| `Alt-h/j/k/l` | focus the tile that way, from the editor too — left of the leftmost is the list |
| `Alt-Shift-h/j/k/l` | move the focused tile that way |
| `L · Shift-Enter` | open the row in a new tile beside the others |
| `gt / gT` | next / previous tile — a view too |
| `Alt-q` | close the focused tile — :close; :only closes the others |
| `j / k · ↓ ↑` | move down / up the list — scroll the document when it has focus |
| `gg / G` | first / last row, or top / bottom of the document — a first g, d, ] or [ waits a second in the status line |
| `Ctrl-D / Ctrl-U` | half a page down / up the open document |
| `zl / zh · zL / zH` | the wide table or code block at the top of the view, sideways — a little, or half its width |
| `]] / \[\[` | next / previous heading of the document — in the editor too |
| `gi` | the info sheet: the open document's headings, earlier versions, backlinks, cards and sharing — Tab between them |
| `gO` | the headings as a list: j/k, Enter jumps there |
| `F` | hints over the links and buttons in view — type one to follow it |
| `gf / gx` | in the editor: follow the link under the cursor / open it in a tab |
| `gx` | open the file under the cursor in a tab of its own |
| `Enter · l` | open a document, or enter a folder — on an open keystore or sealed file, Enter asks for its password |
| `h` | from the document to the list, from the list up a level |
| `o` | new document here, straight into insert mode |
| `O` | new folder here |
| `i · a` | edit the open document |
| `R` | rename what is under the cursor — document, folder or card — starting from its name |
| `m / p` | pick nodes up, then drop them all into the folder you walk to |
| `za` | a document's own files, folded open under it in the list — again folds them away; p drops marked files in there |
| `M` | pick up the whole folder — again puts it all back |
| `Ctrl / Shift-click` | pick a row up · every row up to it — drag them onto a folder |
| `S` | the board, the agenda and the calendar, tiled ahead of what is open with the board focused — S again puts every view away |
| `t` | agenda — late, due this week, in hand, on every board — in a tile of its own |
| `T` | today's diary entry, started if there is none — from templates/day when the diary has one |
| `C` | the diary by month, in a tile: h/l a day, j/k a week, H/L a month, . today, Enter opens or starts the day beside it |
| `[d / ]d` | the diary entry before / after the one open, by date |
| `Ctrl-P` | find anything, in every space — Enter opens the result lit beside them, n goes on |
| `b` | the board, in a tile: this space's, or the last one shown — 1 … 9 there shows another's |
| `c` | capture a card into this space's inbox, without leaving here — reading a document, a card about it; Tab on the line makes it a note, or a line in today's entry |
| `Esc · q` | close the document, and its tile when there are several |
| `/` | full-text search, inside the current space and its text files — Tab or Ctrl-N/P walk the results, Enter opens one |
| `n / N` | next / previous search result, opened beside the results — :noh clears the search |
| `s` | toggle sharing for the document — asks before taking it back |
| `y` | mint a new share link and copy it — asks, the old one stops working |
| `x · dd` | delete what has focus — the row in the list, the document in its pane — into the trash (asks y/N) |
| `u` | undo the last delete: it comes back out of the trash — :trash has the rest |
| `gh` | the open document's earlier versions, as diffs — Enter brings one back |
| `gb` | the documents that link to the open one — \[\[title]] links by title, \[\[ completes one while writing |
| `gc` | the cards about the open document — j/k picks the one :due, :label, Space and H/L act on, Enter turns it over on its board |
| `:` | command line — Tab / Shift-Tab cycle the matches, then the argument; ↑ ↓ recall what ran before |
| `Ctrl-S` | save, from anywhere |
| `?` | this screen, from the editor too — h/l a column, / filters it down |
| `q · Esc` | in a view — the board, the agenda, the calendar, a card's back — close its tile; the focus goes back to the tile before |

### On a board

The first list is the inbox, the last list is done.

| key | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `h / l` | to the list left / right — right of the last, to the tile beside |
| `j / k` | down / up the cards |
| `gg / G` | first / last card of the list |
| `J / K` | move the card down / up its list |
| `H / L` | move the card to the list left / right |
| `Space` | into the done list, or back out to the inbox |
| `Enter` | turn the card over, in a tile beside: its labels, description and checklist |
| `gf` | the card's notes — a document, made on first use; q comes back |
| `o · c` | new card on this list |
| `D` | due date: fri, tm, +3d, 10-31 … |
| `R` | rename the card, or the list when it is empty |
| `z` | show done cards older than a week |
| `F` | a letter over every card in view — type it to put the cursor there |
| `r` | read the board again, for changes made elsewhere |
| `x · dd` | delete the card (asks y/N) |

### On the back of a card

| key | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `j / k` | down / up the checklist |
| `gg / G` | first / last step |
| `Space · x` | tick the step, or untick it |
| `o` | a new step below the cursor — :task on the line |
| `r` | reword the step |
| `J / K` | move the step down / up |
| `dd` | drop the step |
| `e · i · Enter` | write the description, in the editor — it saves itself, :q or Esc in normal mode leaves |
| `a` | put on a label, or take it off — :label on the line, Tab offers the board's |
| `R · D` | rename the card, its due date |
| `H / L` | send the card to the list left / right |
| `gf` | the card's notes — a document, made on first use; q comes back |

### In the agenda

| key | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `j / k` | down / up the cards, then what was written on this day in earlier years, then on to the tile below |
| `h` | to the tile on the left |
| `Enter` | to the card, on its own board beside — or to the entry |
| `Space` | done, where it stands |
| `D` | due date: fri, tm, +3d … — :due on the line |
| `:` | the line, with the agenda kept up — :repeat weekly acts on the card |
| `H / L` | to the list left / right on its board |
| `T` | today's diary entry |

### In the scratchpad

| key | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Q` | lower the scratchpad over whatever is on screen, or raise it again — :scratch <text> takes a note without it |
| `j / k` | down / up the notes, the one touched last on top |
| `o` | a new note, written straight away — it saves itself |
| `Enter · e · i` | write the note — Esc in normal mode, or :q, comes back to the notes |
| `K` | keep the note: a document in the folder being browsed, titled by its first line — :keep <title> names it |
| `C` | make the note a card where :card puts one — the first line its title, the rest its description |
| `A` | put the note at the end of a document — :append, with the one on screen filled in; Tab completes a title |
| `dd` | drop the note (asks y/N) |
| `q · Esc · Q` | raise the scratchpad |

## Commands

A command takes a `!` for its forcing variant where one exists, the way vim's
do: `:w!`, `:space! <name>`, `:import!`.

### Spaces & folders

| command | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `:space, :sp [name]` | switch to a space, or list them |
| `:space!` | create a space with that name and switch to it |
| `:mkdir <name>` | make a folder here |
| `:cd <name\|..\|/>` | enter a folder, .. goes up, / back to the space |
| `:import, :imp` | upload a folder into this one — markdown becomes documents, links follow |
| `:import!` | import loose files, or a .zip of a folder; :import! / pours an :export! back in, spaces and boards and all |
| `:move, :mv <folder\|..\|/>` | move the marked nodes, or else the selected one, into a folder here, up one level, or to the root of the space |
| `:unmark` | put down everything picked up with m |
| `:rmspace, :rms [name]` | delete a space and everything in it, into the trash (asks first) |
| `:trash [purge]` | what was deleted — j/k, Enter brings it back, x deletes it for good; :trash purge empties it |

### Boards

| command | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `:board` | this space's board, in a tile — the last one shown when this space has none |
| `:plan, :special` | the board, the agenda and the calendar, tiled ahead of what is open — S puts them up, and every view away again; 1 … 9 on the board picks the board |
| `:card, :c <title>` | add a card — on the board to the list under the cursor, elsewhere to this space's inbox |
| `:card!` | add a card linked to the open document — gf on it opens the document |
| `:due <when\|->` | due date of the card in focus — on the board, its back, in the agenda, or the open document's: today, tm, fri, +3d, +2w, 10-31, 2026-10-31 — - clears |
| `:repeat <rule\|->` | once the card is done, a copy comes back in the inbox: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, +3d, +2w, +6m — - stops it |
| `:done` | move the card in focus into the done list, or back out to the inbox |
| `:task, :step <text>` | add a step to the open card's checklist, below the cursor |
| `:task!` | reword the step under the cursor |
| `:label <name>` | put a label on the card, or take it off when it has it — each name keeps its colour everywhere |
| `:list <name>` | add a column to the board |
| `:list!` | delete the column under the cursor and every card on it |
| `:agenda, :ag` | what is late, due this week, or in hand — across every board |

### Documents

| command | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `:scratch, :sc [text]` | the scratchpad, lowered over whatever is on screen — Q does the same; with text, a note on it without leaving |
| `:append [document]` | put the scratch note at the end of a document, by its title — Tab completes it — or the one on screen, and take it off the scratchpad |
| `:keep [title]` | make the scratch note a document in the folder being browsed — titled by its first line unless given one — and take it off the scratchpad |
| `:new, :n, :o [template] [yyyy-mm-dd] [name]` | start a new document here — from one of the space's templates, dated, named; in the diary from templates/day |
| `:cal, :calendar` | the diary by month — h/l a day, j/k a week, H/L a month, Enter opens the day or starts it |
| `:today [text]` | open today's diary entry, starting one if there is none yet; with text, a timed line at its end without going there |
| `:next` | open the next node down the list |
| `:prev` | open the previous node |
| `:first` | open the first node in the list |
| `:last` | open the last node in the list |
| `:random` | open something here at random — good for re-reading |
| `:delete, :d, :rm [id]` | delete a node, and everything under it, into the trash (asks first) — u brings it back |
| `:history, :hist` | the open document's earlier versions as diffs — j/k, Enter brings one back (gh) |
| `:backlinks, :bl` | the documents that link to the open one — j/k, Enter opens one (gb) |
| `:cards` | the cards about the open document — its own, and the ones whose summary links here: j/k picks the one :due, :label, Space and H/L act on, Enter turns it over on its board (gc) |
| `:source` | show an open markdown file as written, or rendered again |
| `:outline, :toc` | the open document's headings to pick from — gO, in the editor too |
| `:info [outline\|history\|backlinks\|cards\|files\|share]` | what is known about the open document: its headings, earlier versions, backlinks, cards, files and sharing — Tab between them (gi) |
| `:search, :se [text]` | full-text search in this space (empty clears) |
| `:search!` | full-text search across every space — Ctrl-P |
| `:clear, :noh` | clear the search filter |
| `:reload, :r` | re-read the current folder from the server |

### Tiles

| command | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `:close, :clo` | close the focused tile — Alt-q; asks when its draft could not be written |
| `:only, :on` | close every tile but the focused one |
| `:ls, :buffers, :files` | list the open tiles, % on the focused one |
| `:buffer, :b <n\|name>` | focus a tile by its number in :ls, or by the start of its name |
| `:bnext, :bn` | the next tile — gt |
| `:bprevious, :bp, :bN` | the previous tile — gT |

### Writing

| command | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `:write, :w` | save what is being written — the open document, a card's description, a note — rather than in a moment |
| `:write!` | save even over a newer version saved somewhere else since this one was opened |
| `:wq, :x` | leave the editor with everything written, as :q does |
| `:wq!` | save over a newer version, as :w! does, and leave the editor |
| `:quit, :q` | leave the editor with what is waiting written first, or close the document when already reading |
| `:quit!` | leave the editor, letting go of what is not saved yet |
| `:edit, :e [id]` | edit the open document, or open a node by id |
| `:edit!` | throw away the draft and re-read the document from the server |
| `:name, :title, :rename <text>` | rename what is under the cursor — document, folder, or card on a board; bare, while writing, into the title |
| `:name!` | rename the space you are in — on the board, the list under the cursor |
| `:date <yyyy-mm-dd>` | re-date the open document |
| `:upload, :up` | files for the open document — while writing, embedded at the cursor — or, from the list, into this folder |
| `:upload!` | put files into this folder sealed in the vault — encrypted before they touch the disk |

### Sharing & export

| command | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `:share` | publish the document behind an unguessable link and copy it |
| `:unshare` | revoke the share link |
| `:link` | mint a new share link for the document and copy it |
| `:copy, :yank` | copy the whole document to the clipboard as markdown |
| `:export, :exp` | download the open document as a .md file |
| `:export!` | download the whole workspace — every space, document and file — as a zip |
| `:download, :dl` | download the file under the cursor, or the open one — the open document goes as :export writes it |

### Vault

| command | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `:vault` | whether the vault is open — or, the first time, set its password |
| `:unlock` | open the vault with its password, so sealed files can be read |
| `:lock` | close the vault now — it also closes itself when left alone, and on logout |
| `:passwd` | change the vault's password — every sealed file is then re-sealed under a new key, while the vault is open |
| `:encrypt, :seal` | seal the file under the cursor in the vault — a folder stays sealed: every file in it, and every file added later |
| `:decrypt, :unseal` | take the file under the cursor back out of the vault — on a sealed folder, unseal it and every file inside |

### Session

| command | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `:stats` | word, line and node counts |
| `:set <option>` | vim, novim, clipboard, noclipboard, board, noboard |
| `:backup [login <proton-username> \| logout]` | when the workspace was last mirrored to proton drive — login sets the mirror up, logout forgets its session |
| `:backup!` | back up to proton drive now, rather than when the workspace falls quiet |
| `:sessions [rm <n>]` | every browser signed in, numbered — rm signs one of them out, and locks the vault |
| `:sshkey [add <name> <key> \| rm <name> \| vault <name> on\|off]` | list, add or remove keys allowed to mount the workspace over sftp, and say which may read sealed files |
| `:token [add <name> \| rm <name>]` | list, add or remove tokens that capture into the workspace from outside it — add shows the token once and copies it |
| `:help, :h` | show the key and command reference |
| `:logout` | end the session |
| `:logout!` | end every session, on every device — for a lost phone or a shared computer |
